description:
This Conti is like nothing else out there. All decisions were made using fun as our spirit guide.

We started with a s/m Conti frameset for a short wheelbase and flickable geo…ready to dial in your wheelies, 180 rollouts, maybe a bar spin? This is the gateway. 165mm cranks with a higher bb play super nice the 26+ wheelset. Fun fun fun fun fun fun.

At its heart is some very nice bits…i9 1/1 hubs, that killer odyssey BMX crankset, trp slate brakes. Thomson stem and post. Doomonē 🌶️ collab BMX rise bars…it's just get better the more you dig in.

Routed for bar spins, because why not? “Dropper” for commuting. This thing is ready to tour to a skate park and back again. Maybe set your tent up in the half pipe.

This won't appeal to everyone… but if you see the radness like i do…this is an opportunity to own a killer monē for little money. One of my faves in recent history
